```{r setup}
if (!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("here")
library(IMIFA)
library(tidyverse)
library(mclust)
```


```{r}
source(here::here("R", "simfun.R"))
source(here::here("R", "group_sparse_mifa.R"))
```

```{r}
sim <- simfun(
  n = 50,
  p = 60,
  q = c(2, 3, 4),
  active = 5,
  loadings = c(2, 4, 6),
  psi = 1,
  seed = 200
)

fit <- group_sparse_mifa(
  X = sim$X,
  G = sim$G,
  K = 8,
  n_iter = 6000,
  burn = 2000,
  thin = 2,
  rank_prop = 0.99,
  rank_abs = 1.5,
  z_init = sim$z_true,
  update_z = TRUE,
  equal_weights = TRUE,
  truth = sim,
  seed = 700,
  verbose = FALSE
)
```


```{r}
cat("\nData and simulation truth\n")
print(fit$data_info)
print(fit$truth_info)

cat("\nClustering\n")
print(c(
  RI = fit$clustering$RI,
  ARI = fit$clustering$ARI,
  accuracy = fit$clustering$accuracy
))
print(fit$clustering$confusion_matrix)

cat("\nCluster-specific effective factor dimension\n")
print(fit$factor_summary, row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nRow selection and shrinkage recovery\n")
print(fit$row_summary, row.names = FALSE)
print(fit$selected_rows)
print(fit$true_active_rows)
print(fit$selected_true_rows)

cat("\nGlobal and cluster shrinkage\n")
print(fit$global_shrinkage$omega, row.names = FALSE)
print(fit$global_shrinkage$threshold, row.names = FALSE)
print(fit$global_shrinkage$sigma, row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nCovariance recovery\n")
print(fit$covariance_summary, row.names = FALSE)

# Detailed posterior objects are retained in fit and viewed only when needed.
fit$row_pip[1:10, , drop = FALSE]
fit$row_norm[1:10, , drop = FALSE]
fit$psi_mean[1:10, , drop = FALSE]
fit$mu_mean[1:10, , drop = FALSE]
fit$eigen_mean
fit$tau_mean
fit$global_shrinkage$tau_final
fit$column_diagnostics

```


```{r}
source("R/simfun.R")
source("R/group_sparse_imifa.R")

test_group_sparse_imifa <- function(
  n_iter = 6000, burn = 2000, thin = 2,
  pyp_concentration = 0.5, pyp_discount = 0.1,
  slice_rho = 0.75, G_max = 40,
  a_psi = 20, bpsi_shape = 38, bpsi_rate = 2,
  spectral_init = TRUE,
  splits_per_cluster = 1L,
  seed = 700, verbose = FALSE, print_result = TRUE
) {
  sim <- simfun(
    n = 50,
    p = 60,
    q = c(2, 3, 4),
    active = 5,
    loadings = c(2, 4, 6),
    psi = 1,
    seed = 200
  )

  set.seed(seed + 1L)
  label <- sim$G * splits_per_cluster
  if (splits_per_cluster == 1L) {
    z_init <- sample.int(sim$G)[sim$z_true]
  } else {
    z_init <- integer(length(sim$z_true))
    offset <- 0L
    for (g in seq_len(sim$G)) {
      ind <- which(sim$z_true == g)
      split <- sample(rep(seq_len(splits_per_cluster), length.out = length(ind)))
      z_init[ind] <- offset + split
      offset <- offset + splits_per_cluster
    }
    z_init <- sample.int(label)[z_init]
  }

  fit <- group_sparse_imifa(
    X = sim$X,
    K = 8,
    n_iter = n_iter,
    burn = burn,
    thin = thin,
    G_init = label,
    G_max = G_max,
    pyp_concentration = pyp_concentration,
    pyp_discount = pyp_discount,
    slice_rho = slice_rho,
    a_psi = a_psi,
    bpsi_shape = bpsi_shape,
    bpsi_rate = bpsi_rate,
    spectral_init = spectral_init,
    rank_prop = 0.99,
    rank_abs = 1.5,
    z_init = z_init,
    truth = sim,
    seed = seed,
    verbose = verbose
  )

  checks <- c(
    total_sample_size_is_150 = nrow(sim$X) == 150L,
    initial_G_is_expected = length(unique(z_init)) == sim$G * splits_per_cluster,
    initial_sizes_are_balanced = diff(range(tabulate(z_init, label))) <= 1L,
    posterior_G_mode_is_true = fit$pyp$G_summary$mode == sim$G,
    dahl_G_is_true = fit$pyp$G_summary$dahl == sim$G,
    dahl_clusters_are_not_dust = isTRUE(
      length(fit$clustering$estimated_cluster_sizes) == sim$G &&
        min(fit$clustering$estimated_cluster_sizes) >= sim$n / 2
    ),
    effective_q_is_true = isTRUE(nrow(fit$factor_summary) == sim$G &&
      all(fit$factor_summary$q_mode == sim$q)),
    row_F1_is_one = isTRUE(nrow(fit$row_summary) == sim$G &&
      all(fit$row_summary$F1 == 1)),
    active_psi_is_controlled = isTRUE(nrow(fit$row_summary) == sim$G &&
      all(fit$row_summary$active_psi < 1.5)),
    tau_is_strictly_increasing = isTRUE(all(apply(
      fit$global_shrinkage$tau_final, 2, function(x) all(diff(x) > 0)
    ))),
    pyp_weights_are_valid = all(fit$mix_store >= 0) &&
      all(rowSums(fit$mix_store) <= 1 + 1e-12) &&
      all(fit$tail_mass_store >= -1e-12),
    slice_has_enough_proposals = all(fit$slice_store >= fit$G_store),
    slice_cap_is_rare = fit$pyp$slice_summary$cap_hit_probability <= 0.01
  )

  if (print_result) {
    cat("\nSimulation and initialization\n")
    print(c(
      N = nrow(sim$X), P = ncol(sim$X), true_G = sim$G,
      initial_G = length(unique(z_init)), G_max = G_max,
      splits_per_cluster = splits_per_cluster
    ))
    print(table(initial_cluster = z_init))

    cat("\nPYP cluster-number recovery\n")
    print(fit$pyp$G_summary, row.names = FALSE)
    print(fit$pyp$G_distribution, row.names = FALSE)

    cat("\nClustering\n")
    print(c(
      RI = fit$clustering$RI,
      ARI = fit$clustering$ARI,
      accuracy = fit$clustering$accuracy
    ))
    print(fit$clustering$confusion_matrix)

    cat("\nWithin-cluster effective factors\n")
    print(fit$factor_summary, row.names = FALSE)

    cat("\nWithin-cluster row recovery\n")
    print(fit$row_summary, row.names = FALSE)

    cat("\nRegression checks\n")
    print(checks)
  }

  invisible(list(simulation = sim, z_init = z_init, fit = fit, checks = checks))
}
```


```{r}
result <- test_group_sparse_imifa()                       # preserve 3 x 50
result_overfit <- test_group_sparse_imifa(splits_per_cluster = 3L) # 9 -> 3
```


```{r}
fit <- result_overfit$fit
fit$pyp
fit$global_shrinkage
fit$row_pip[1:10, , drop = FALSE]
fit$row_norm[1:10, , drop = FALSE]
fit$psi_mean[1:10, , drop = FALSE]
fit$column_diagnostics
```
